info.name: Spring Boot 3 Actuator Environment Metrics API

items.docs: Returns a list of all registered Micrometer metric names available in this application.

params.name: metricName
params.description: Name of the metric (e.g., jvm.memory.used, http.server.requests)

params.name: tag
params.description: Tag filter in name:value format (may be repeated)

items.docs: Returns measurements and available tags for a specific Micrometer metric. Use tag parameters to filter by dimension.
